job.job_description:
Hi,




PFB Job description and kindly connect and let me know if interested or Share your CV on sairam.m.naik@pwc.com or if you have any references it will be helpful.




Senior Associate Full Stack Developer (Data & Backend Engineering)

PwC US Acceleration Center




Responsibilities

Collaborated with product owners, LLM engineers, data engineers, cloud/platform teams, and security teams to deliver enterprise-scale backend and full stack solutions.
Designed and developed scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs and microservices for AI-driven applications.
Built and optimized ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch and streaming workflows.
Implemented data ingestion, transformation, validation, and orchestration processes.
Designed and managed relational, NoSQL, and data warehouse systems.
Developed event-driven architecture using Kafka, Azure Service Bus, and Pub/Sub.
Integrated backend systems with LLM platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud data platforms.
Built frontend applications using ReactJS, Streamlit, and Django.
Collaborated with UX designers, product managers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into intuitive, user-centered interfaces.
Designed and implemented responsive, accessible, and cross-browser compatible UI components using modern frontend frameworks.
Optimized frontend performance through code-splitting, lazy loading, caching strategies, and bundle size reduction.
Implemented role-based UI personalization and dynamic rendering based on user permissions and enterprise security policies.
Integrated frontend applications with RESTful and GraphQL APIs to enable seamless data exchange between UI and backend microservices.
Implemented Docker-based containerization and Kubernetes orchestration.
Ensured scalability, security, governance, and compliance with data privacy standards.
Implemented observability practices including logging, tracing, and monitoring.
Conducted load testing and performance optimization.
Used Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation) for cloud deployments.
Contributed to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.

Core Requirements

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
4–6+ years of experience in backend engineering, data engineering, or distributed systems.
Strong programming expertise in Python, PySpark, and SQL.
Hands-on experience building and deploying RESTful or GraphQL APIs in production.
Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, batch processing, and streaming systems.
Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
Experience with event-driven architecture (Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Pub/Sub).
Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability engineering.
Knowledge of data privacy, governance, and compliance standards.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
Ability to develop front-end applications using Python, ReactJS & Streamlit

Nice to Have Skills

Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Azure Data Factory.
Experience with data validation frameworks and data quality monitoring tools.
Experience working with data warehouses such as Snowflake, Synapse, or BigQuery.
Experience with object storage platforms such as Azure Blob Storage, Amazon S3, or Google Cloud Storage.
Experience implementing caching solutions using Redis.
Familiarity with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Experience with load testing tools such as K6, JMeter, or Postman.
Experience integrating backend systems with LLM platforms or AI-driven applications.



Education

BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc / M.E / M.Tech / Master’s Degree / MBA from a reputed institute
